content.text: Most tutorials about building a digital store focus on the storefront. The storefront is the last thing you should configure. The backend is what makes the store work — and the backend is what most creators get wrong when they try to build without a clear sequence. In Stack 01, Google Apps Script serves as the backend Web App — it receives the NOWPayments webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction on-chain, logs the order to Google Sheets, and sends the delivery email via Gmail. In Stack 02, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-every-detail-5|Cloudflare R2]] Workers replaces Apps Script with a faster, more scalable serverless backend that integrates natively with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-crypto-payment-gateways-14|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-23|supabase]] for order storage and Resend for email delivery. Configure the backend first, set the webhook endpoint URL in NOWPayments second, build the storefront third, and test on mainnet fourth.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to thriving in a landscape where platforms fail is infrastructure sovereignty. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, you gain a hosting solution that is fast, secure, and independent. This means you won't experience downtime or restrictions due to third-party policies. Combined with NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing, you maintain full control over your store and customer data. This architecture is designed specifically for those who have been locked out by existing platforms, ensuring that your business runs smoothly regardless of external circumstances.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, gather the necessary tools and accounts. You need a Cloudflare account to set up your Pages, a Google account for Apps Script, and access to NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with your products and prepare digital assets for upload. If you're considering the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll benefit from a complete deployment in 48 hours, including configuration for SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security and server-side logic using Workers and Supabase, setting the stage for a reliable digital storefront.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing your payment and delivery pipeline is critical. First, configure NOWPayments to connect to your Cloudflare store. Use the NOWPayments API to create a webhook that confirms transactions on-chain. Next, integrate Google Apps Script to manage order processing, automating delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. This setup ensures that when a customer pays, they receive their product instantly, enhancing customer satisfaction and trust in your store.
Your infrastructure is your power; own it, don't rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once everything is configured, it's time to go live. Push your changes to Cloudflare Pages and conduct thorough testing. Ensure that your payment processing works smoothly by making a test purchase. This step is crucial to confirm that all hooks are firing correctly and orders are being processed as expected. Once you've validated that everything functions properly, you're ready to launch your store. Promote your products through social media and other channels, driving traffic to your new crypto store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your digital store, focus on scaling your operations. Monitor sales and customer feedback to identify opportunities for new products or improvements. With your infrastructure set up, adding more products is straightforward. Leverage analytics from Supabase to inform your decisions. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack if you’re looking for more robust features, as it allows for greater customization and scalability. Engage with your community to build loyalty and maximize your store's potential.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploying is not a hustle; it's a strategic move for your business.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a crypto payment system?

To set up a crypto payment system, register with NOWPayments and integrate it with your store's backend using their API. This allows for seamless transaction processing without the need for traditional payment platforms.
What differentiates Stack 01 from Stack 02?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. Stack 02, on the other hand, uses Cloudflare Pages and Workers for a more robust setup, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages, but Stack 02 with Cloudflare Pages offers more features and scalability, especially for handling backend logic and payment processing.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, with no KYC requirements or buyer accounts needed. This makes it an accessible option for digital creators in restricted regions.
How can I ensure my store is secure?
To ensure your store is secure, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security and use HTTPS for your Cloudflare Pages. Regularly monitor access logs and keep your backend updated.
